reviews.text: OMG!!!  We would give 500 stars if we could!  Samantha changed our lives by teaching ‘our Jerry’ good manners!  We worked with a trainer several years ago who boarded our dog. She did a good job with him but was not very personable nor very good at explaining the “what’s and how’s” to us. We managed to figure out a lot but it wasn’t always easy. Samantha spent an amazing amount of time going over so many things with us, never talking down nor making us feel like our questions were dumb or annoying. We learned SO MUCH during our “training session”!  When we got back home, Jerry was obviously very happy to be home but he did wonderfully well with his newly learned “manners”.  He was very noticeably pretty much exhausted from all of the work and excitement of graduation and returning home so he has rested a good bit but he is doing amazingly well with his commands. We can’t begin to express how grateful we are to have found All Dogs Unleashed and their staff. I will never be able to recommend them enough!!!!

Can’t say enough good things about our trainer Jake!
Very informative and straight forward. He did an awesome job with our dog Duke!! So glad I sent Duke to get trained at all dogs unleashed.

Samantha did an AMAZING job with my golden doodle! Before All Dogs Unleashed, he was way too excited around people and dogs on a leash. Now, he has self control! He is also learning place actively at home and also learning between right and wrong as well.

Had the best experience with my 2 week board and train program for my 1 year old Boston terrier! They did all the basic training as well as the more advanced commands like place and come which for us was a big one! Our trainer Samantha was so knowledgeable and really cared about our dogs progress and took the time to explain everything to us at graduation. Overall the experience was so good and the facility was very clean which is always a plus and couldn’t be happier with our results!

I post under a pseudonym because I’m a private person However, I really did use the services of All Dogs Unleashed.

I picked up my Precious Pit today from board and train - 2 weeks long. Sam, my dog’s personal trainer for the duration of my Pup’s stay, provided me with an excellent two hour training session upon pick up. She explained all of the equipment thoroughly and made sure I had an understanding of it. She demonstrated my Pup’s skills and then she had me practice the skills and using the equipment. She answered my multitude of questions with patience, Knowledge, and understanding. Although I know my Pup’s ultimate success lies with me and my solid follow through in the foundations that were built at ADU, I walked away feeling confident and optimistic. We will definitely be returning for refreshers. I can tell my Pup had a good time and was treated well. Everyone I met (staff) while dropping Pup off and then throughout my two hour session today were super nice, genuine, and knowledgeable.

A side note- She’s completely passed out right now after 2 weeks!
